title: nmrForge: automation, parameter optimisation and quality control for Bruker multidimensional NMR data
description: nmrForge automates Bruker multidimensional NMR data processing: it reads acquisition parameters, identifies the experiment type and sampling scheme, plans and executes an NMRPipe processing strategy (with SMILE reconstruction for non-uniform sampling), performs quality control, and records the resolved parameters, external tool versions and warnings for reproducibility and audit.
